description: One call, live U.S. government feeds: quakes (USGS M2.5+ past day), storms (NHC active cyclones), alerts (NWS Severe/Extreme), tides (NOAA latest water level, 10 stations), recalls (FDA food enforcement + USDA FSIS), treasury (debt to the penny + daily par yield curve), filings (SEC latest filings). Each section has source URL and retrieved_at; cached 5-30 min. Params sections (comma list, default all), limit per section. Not a safety service; not investment advice. $0.005

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
